title: Restart & Checkpoint Sufficiency Architecture
qualification_detail: all 53 ARCH01 state/non-state families have explicit restart treatment; physical, externally coordinated, recomputed, diagnostic continuation and conditional feature/owner state are separated; accepted-boundary-only checkpoint semantics are defined
architecture_decisions: portable checkpoints are created only at accepted transaction boundaries
uncommitted trial state and transfer-journal events are never normal restart payload
ANIMO-owned physical stores are checkpointed in canonical owner representation
hydrological state required by ANIMO is restored by the external hydrology owner rather than duplicated inside the ANIMO physical checkpoint
crop restart ownership is explicit and depends on whether ANIMO or an external crop model owns the crop compartment
derived views and step-local scratch are reconstructed rather than serialized
site-resolved phosphorus state is checkpointed site-resolved rather than only through derived totals
GHG and macropore state remain conditional and cannot be admitted solely because restartable legacy arrays exist
diagnostic continuation state is distinct from physical model state
mid-report-period output continuity requires diagnostic continuation payload or checkpointing at a reporting reset boundary
restore fails closed on incompatible time, geometry, feature layout, site count, ownership mode or schema identity

lineage_note.reason: the PREP08 restart branch remains a reservation while another PREP08 workstream already contains substantive work; ARCH02 prevents identifier collision and starts from ARCH01

remaining_blockers: MIGRATION_DAG still requires qualified migration baseline QM before canonical STATE admission
PREP02 historical or independently trusted reference environment remains unresolved
controlled immutable B0 retention remains a separate governance gate
generic TIME and acceptance/retry semantics are not yet qualified
no frozen-reference split-run versus uninterrupted restart equivalence test exists
supplied testbank has no active macropore case
external SWAP/WOFOST coordinated checkpoint identity contract is not yet qualified

parallel_now: derive a candidate MassLedger observer schema from ARCH01 typed transfers and PREP06 conservation identities without admitting the MASS gate
define a feature activation and state-allocation matrix for crop GHG macropore and surface-reservoir components
prepare a future split-run restart qualification specification for use once a qualified reference environment exists
continue PREP02 reference recovery and controlled B0 retention independently
serial_after_qm: qualify or revise ARCH01 as canonical STATE
then behaviourally qualify ARCH02 restart equivalence and canonical checkpoint semantics
